claims: Long Island University (LIU) is a private, multicampus institution.
Long Island University (LIU) was founded in 1926.
Long Island University (LIU) has major campuses in Brooklyn and Brookville (Post), New York.
Long Island University (LIU) offers over 150 degree programs.
Long Island University (LIU) has a 13:1 student-faculty ratio.
U.S. News & World Report ranks Long Island University (LIU) #373 in National Universities.
Applicants for LIU Global require a minimum 2.50 GPA.
Undergraduate tuition and fees at Long Island University (LIU) are approximately $42,432 per year.
Estimated tuition and fees at Long Island University (LIU) range from $32,448 to over $85,000 per year depending on the program and housing, according to INTO Study.
The average net price at Long Island University (LIU) for federal loan recipients is $25,774.
Long Island University (LIU) has a network of over 200,000 alumni.
David Antin is a LIU Post alumnus of 1997.
David Antin is CEO of Institutional Investor Publishing Division.
Robert Arning is a LIU Post alumnus of 1984.
Robert Arning is Vice Chair of Market Development at KPMG Inc.
The LIU Sharks compete in NCAA Division I.
The Brookings Institution recognized Long Island University (LIU) for "value added" to student outcomes.
